source_script: Person A: I had my second baby seven months ago and the gym childcare line was longer than my actual workout, so I gave up for a while. Now I loop this band around my bedroom door twice a day while the baby naps and I get through a full set before she wakes up. Person B: I live in a four hundred square foot studio and a squat rack was never happening for me. I hook the same band around my closet door handle right after I get home from work and do rows for ten minutes before I even take my shoes off.
